program.name: Process Engineering
program.summary: BSc in Process Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, 3 years, taught in English; Cremona campus.

costs.note: 2026/2027: the yearly amount depends on family income. EUR 3,943.04 is the maximum (all-inclusive contribution), charged when no ISEE is submitted; with an ISEE of up to EUR 22,000 it is EUR 157.04. With income or assets abroad you need an ISEEU parificato from an affiliated CAF to pay less.

living.note: Our calculation: the top of each monthly range in Politecnico di Milano's cost-of-living guide (accommodation EUR 700, food EUR 200, social life EUR 200, travel EUR 30, mobile phone EUR 30) × 12 = EUR 13,920 a year. Study costs aren't included; PoliMi says it is impossible to calculate them.

admissions.threshold: Process Engineering: no school-grade cut-off. Places on English-taught programmes go by ranking on an entrance test: Politecnico's own test (TOL), or the CEnT-S or SAT, both taken in English. English proficiency must be shown before enrolment. Non-EU applicants living abroad also apply for a study visa through the Universitaly portal. (2026/2027 call; the next call isn't published yet.)

tests.name: TOL, CEnT-S or SAT (entrance test ranking)

english.min_score: TOEFL iBT 59 (total), IELTS Academic 5, or Cambridge B2 First grade C. Not needed with a high school qualification awarded in English.
english.notes: Italian isn't an admission requirement; without it you get Additional Educational Obligations to clear during the degree.
